column3: “It will become into laughter” is rendered “You will be laughed at.”
“Break its fragments” is rendered “gnaw its fragments.”
“Children” is rendered “sons,” and NASB supplies “the fire.”
The written text reads “drunkards,” the reading tradition “Sabeans”; NASB has “drunkards.”
The Hebrew is very difficult; NASB has “Will they now commit adultery with her.” The meaning is uncertain.
“He went into her” is rendered “they went in to her.”
“People will requite” is rendered “will be requited,” and “sins of your idols” as “penalty of worshiping your idols.”
